title: 'Forgotten Island' scene sparks a proudly Filipino reaction online
summary: A clip from DreamWorks Animation’s upcoming film ‘Forgotten Island’ went viral online, with Filipino viewers calling out just how “aggressively Filipino” one particular…

blocks.text: A clip from DreamWorks Animation’s upcoming film ‘Forgotten Island’ went viral online, with Filipino viewers calling out just how “aggressively Filipino” one particular scene was, and the internet could not stop pointing out the details. The scene packed in a laundry list of hyper-specific, deeply relatable Pinoy household staples: a Jesus portrait on the wall, lechon on the table, hotdogs on sticks with marshmallows, lumpia, pancit, the iconic lip-pointing instead of using a hand, an uncle confidently belting away on karaoke, and a “mano po” gesture toward an elder while a crowd of relatives and neighbors packed the frame.
